# Hägvall Labs

> Hägvall Labs is a Swedish software business that builds software for information security, privacy and artificial intelligence. Its first product, Maskera, finds and masks personal data in text before it is used in AI systems, logs or analytics tools.

Key facts:

- Company: Hägvall Labs AB (Swedish org. no. 559598-0110, Stockholm, Sweden), founded and run by Joel Hägvall
- Focus: information security, privacy, artificial intelligence
- First product: Maskera (https://maskera.dev), which detects and masks personal data (names, personal identity numbers, addresses, phone numbers) in free text before it reaches AI systems, logs or analytics tools; built for Swedish text and Swedish personal data formats
- Open artifacts: Maskera source on GitHub (https://github.com/joelhagvall/maskera), package on npm (https://www.npmjs.com/package/maskera), Swedish NER model on Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/joelhagvall/maskera-sv-ner)
- Deployment: primarily self-hosted, installed in the customer's own IT environment; no data leaves the customer's infrastructure
- Offering: software development, APIs and integrations, AI SDK implementation and automation, information security and privacy consulting; Maskera pilot projects, software licenses, installation and support
- Way of working: AI-assisted development (Codex, Claude, MCP) with CI/CD and strict quality gates; small fast releases; the site itself scores top marks in Lighthouse on every page, with perfect scores for accessibility and SEO, measured daily against the live site by a public GitHub Actions workflow and shown in the site footer
- Privacy: the website uses no cookies and runs privacy-friendly, self-hosted visitor analytics with Umami; replay, heatmaps and identified users are disabled; live analytics data is retained for 90 days and recovery backups for 7 additional days
- Market: companies and organizations, primarily in Sweden; direct sales via website, digital contact, demonstrations and agreements
- Payment: invoice and bank transfer
- Operations: fully online
- Founder and responsible: Joel Hägvall (https://joelhagvall.com, LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/joel-h%C3%A4gvall-810601147/, GitHub: https://github.com/joelhagvall)
- Contact: work@joelhagvall.com
